dashboard.hubSubtitle: Choose a card below to view its tools.

crop-soil.title: Crop & Soil Intelligence
crop-soil.subtitle: Crop advisory, soil health analysis, nutrient planning, and crop rotation.

crop-advisory.title: Crop Advisory
crop-advisory.description: Seasonal crop selection and stage-by-stage field guidance tailored to your soil, irrigation, and district.
crop-advisory.status: Works with or without soil report
crop-advisory.integrationNote: Uses your saved district, season, irrigation source, land area, and soil profile to frame seasonal crop advisory.
steps: Review your active growing season, land area in acres, and irrigation source.
Compare recommended crop options suited to your soil class and water availability.
Follow sowing spacing, weed control, and irrigation timing for your selected crop.

soil-health-analysis.title: Soil Health Analysis
soil-health-analysis.description: Review your saved Soil Health Card readings or field soil baseline in plain language.
soil-health-analysis.integrationNote: Displays your saved soil test values or field baseline. Regional lab thresholds will connect in the next update.
steps: Review recorded soil test readings or basic soil type from your profile.
Note any parameters marked as Unknown for future testing.
Use organic compost and balanced soil care before sowing.

fertilizer-planner.title: Fertilizer & Nutrient Planner
fertilizer-planner.description: Plan basal compost and split fertilizer dosages adjusted for your farm area.
fertilizer-planner.integrationNote: Tailors fertilizer and organic manure planning to your saved acres and crop.
steps: Verify your saved land size in acres before estimating fertilizer bags.
Apply nitrogen in split doses across growth stages instead of a single application.
Combine chemical nutrients with farmyard manure or green manure.

crop-rotation.title: Crop Rotation Guide
crop-rotation.description: Alternate cereals, pulses, and oilseeds to restore soil fertility and reduce pests.
crop-rotation.integrationNote: Uses your recorded current or previous crop to suggest soil-restoring next-season sequences.
steps: Review the current or previous crop saved in your farm profile.
Follow heavy-feeding cereals with nitrogen-fixing pulse crops such as Tur, Moong, or Bengal Gram.
Incorporate crop residues cleanly between seasons.

plant-health.title: Plant Health & Protection
plant-health.subtitle: Pest & disease diagnosis and safe crop protection practices.

pest-disease-diagnosis.title: Pest & Disease Diagnosis
pest-disease-diagnosis.description: Check leaf spots, yellowing, wilting, and pest symptoms systematically.
pest-disease-diagnosis.integrationNote: Leaf photo analysis will connect in a future update alongside this structured symptom checklist.
steps: Inspect affected plant parts (young leaves, older leaves, stems, or roots).
Check undersides of leaves for aphids, mites, caterpillars, or fungal spots.
Assess whether damage is uniform across the field or confined to patches.

crop-protection-guide.title: Crop Protection & Spray Guide
crop-protection-guide.description: Integrated pest controls, safe dosage preparation, and spray timing precautions.
crop-protection-guide.integrationNote: Will link with live wind and rain spray windows in the weather update.
steps: Use yellow sticky traps, pheromone traps, and clean field borders first.
Avoid spraying during peak afternoon heat or ahead of forecasted rainfall.
Follow label dilution ratios and pre-harvest waiting periods.

market-weather.title: Market & Weather
market-weather.subtitle: Local weather forecasts and nearby APMC mandi market prices.

weather-forecast.title: Weather Forecast
weather-forecast.description: Track rain, temperature, humidity, and wind windows for sowing and harvesting.
weather-forecast.integrationNote: Live 7-day forecast from Open-Meteo will connect to your saved village and district.
steps: Check upcoming rainfall before sowing, top-dressing, or spraying.
Monitor high-humidity periods that favor fungal diseases.
Plan harvesting and grain drying during clear dry spells.

mandi-prices.title: Mandi Market Prices
mandi-prices.description: Compare crop prices across nearby regulated markets before selling.
mandi-prices.integrationNote: Live Agmarknet mandi prices and nearby market maps will connect in an upcoming update.
steps: Select your harvested crop and review rates in nearby district mandis.
Factor transport costs when comparing modal prices across markets.
Grade and dry produce properly before market arrival.

agri-services.title: Agricultural Services
agri-services.subtitle: Government farm schemes, crop insurance, and soil testing laboratories.

govt-schemes.title: Government Schemes & Subsidies
govt-schemes.description: Check eligibility and required documents for farm support, micro-irrigation, and crop insurance.
govt-schemes.integrationNote: Aligned with your saved state, land area in acres, and irrigation source.
steps: Keep land records (RTC / Pahani), Aadhaar, and bank passbook updated.
Verify seasonal crop insurance enrollment deadlines for your taluk.
Submit applications at your nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or CSC.

soil-testing-labs.title: Soil Testing Laboratories
soil-testing-labs.description: Locate soil testing labs and follow standard sample collection steps.
soil-testing-labs.integrationNote: Especially useful for farmers who onboarded without a Soil Health Card.
steps: Collect composite soil samples from 6 to 8 spots at 15 cm depth.
Air-dry in shade, mix evenly, and label with plot and farmer details.
Submit at your district Krishi Vigyan Kendra or soil testing lab and update your profile.

ai-assistant.title: AI Farmer Assistant
ai-assistant.subtitle: Bilingual crop and soil advisory assistant in English and Kannada.

ai-crop-assistant.title: AI Crop & Soil Assistant
ai-crop-assistant.description: Ask practical questions about crops, soil, pests, and seasons in English or Kannada.
ai-crop-assistant.integrationNote: Will connect to the Gemini API via the backend server using your saved farm profile and chosen language.
steps: Your saved district, acres, crop, and language frame every question automatically.
Responses are explicitly requested in English or Kannada.
Cross-check chemical recommendations with local agricultural officers.

soil-report-explainer.title: Soil Report Explainer
soil-report-explainer.description: Translate technical soil test values into simple field actions.
soil-report-explainer.integrationNote: Connects your stored soil readings or field baseline to plain-language explanations.
steps: Review your saved nutrient and pH readings (or field details).
Request plain-language explanations for low or high values.
Update your profile whenever new lab test results arrive.
